evidence_refs: fact:monotonic improvement from t-3w to t-0w

If PARKS continues improving, RETAIL_REC will follow via the same constraint-relaxation mechanism.

failure_condition: TRANSIT improves to above -35% within the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC rises above -25% despite TRANSIT remaining below -40%.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped from -23.9% to -29.0% in t-0w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES recovers to above -25% in the next week, or RETAIL_REC improves by >3 points despite WORKPLACES remaining below -28%.

candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above 12% AND WORKPLACES below -25%
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL drops below 10% or WORKPLACES recovers above -20%, or RETAIL_REC rises above -28% despite both conditions holding.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS +17.4 points vs RETAIL_REC +6.8 points over 4 weeks
